DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.visible, IFNULL( m.perms, '' ) AS perms, m.is_frame, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time, m.remark, m.menu_classify, m.menu_apply, m.`status`
mapper.select:
select * from ( select DISTINCT me.menu_id, me.parent_id, me.menu_name, me.path, me.component, me.visible, IFNULL(me.perms, '' ) AS perms, me.is_frame, me.menu_type, me.icon, me.order_num, me.create_time, me.remark, me.menu_classify, me.menu_apply, me.`status` from sys_menu me INNER JOIN ( ) a ON a.PARENT_ID = me.MENU_ID and me.MENU_TYPE='M'
union
) m
order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path,m.`status`, m.component, m.visible, IFNULL(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time,m.remark,m.menu_classify,menu_apply from sys_menu m where (m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.visible = '0' and m.`status`='0') or m.path='/indexPermission' order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name,m.`status`, m.path, m.component, m.visible, IFNULL(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time,m.remark,m.menu_classify,m.file_url from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.visible = '0' and m.`status`='0'
and m.menu_apply
#{item}

SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_id FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.menu_id = m.menu_id inner JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ri ON ri.auth_id = ia.auth_id WHERE ri.role_id = #{roleId} AND ia.industry_code=#{industryCode} AND ia.app_ver_code=#{appVerCode} and m.`status`='0'

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.visible, IFNULL( m.perms, '' ) AS perms, m.is_frame, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time, m.remark, m.menu_classify, m.menu_apply, m.`status` FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.menu_id = m.menu_id inner JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ri ON ri.auth_id = ia.auth_id WHERE ri.role_id = #{roleId} and m.`status`='0' ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.menu_id = m.menu_id inner JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ri ON ri.auth_id = ia.auth_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ri.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ri ON ri.role_id = r.role_id inner JOIN sys_industry_auth ia ON ia.auth_id = ri.auth_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.MENU_ID = ia.menu_id where r.del_flag = '0' and ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ia.industry_code=#{industryCode} AND ia.app_ver_code=#{appVerCode} and m.`status`='0' and m.visible = '0' and m.menu_apply
